en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 90 - Among that which is narrated by Abu Abdullah Ahmad bin Abdun, alias Ibnal Hashir is: Narrated to me Abul Hasan Muhammad bin Ali Shujai, the scribe that: Narrated to us Abu Abdullah Muhammad bin Ibrahim, alias Ibn Abu Zainab Nomani, the scribe that: Narrated to us Muhammad bin Uthman bin Allaan Zahabi Baghdadi in Damascus: Narrated to us Abu Bakr bin Abu Khaithama that: Narrated to me Ali bin Jaud that: Zuhair bin Muawiyah from Ziyad bin Khaithama from Aswad bin Saeed Hamadani that: I heard Jabir bin Samra say: I heard the Messenger of Allah (s) say:

After me, there would be twelve Caliphs and all of them would be from Quraish. When the Messenger of Allah (s) returned to his house, Quraish arrived and addressed the Prophet: What will happen after that? The Prophet replied: Confusion and discord.
